name: Fix JSON Parse Errors in Write Tool
description: Fix systematic JSON parse errors when write tool receives long content by adding validation and streaming support

prompt.template:
Files with write tool:
{{locate-write-tool.output}}

Read these files and identify:
1. Where write tool validates params
2. Current max content length (if any)
3. How to add write_streaming support
4. Where to add validation for content.length > 1000

expected_outputs.name: validation_added
expected_outputs.description: Write tool validates content length and rejects if >1000 chars

success_criteria: Write tool rejects content >1000 chars with clear error message
Error message suggests using bash with heredoc
No JSON parse errors for long content writes
